mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 59 degrees and partly cloudy at Verona City Hall under a full moon. The ISS passes overhead tonight, but you won't be able to see it due to the clouds. We are looking at an overnight low of 50 degrees with no rain predicted.

The City of Verona is currently moving forward with the 2027 budget planning process and reviewing several development proposals, including the Ardent Glen project and new site plans on Milky Way, which will be discussed by the Plan Commission on November 4th.

We have a busy schedule! Today, catch live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard and Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, check out yoga at Insight Wellness. Looking ahead, mark your calendars for trivia at various local spots throughout the week and the Main Street Trick or Treat on October 29th.
Regarding the latest police report, on Thursday, October 15, the Verona Police Department arrested a school bus driver for operating while impaired, an incident that remains under investigation.
Today's flavor of the day was Snickers Swirl, but the store is now closed for the night. Please join us tomorrow when we open at 10:00 AM to enjoy our upcoming flavor, Pumpkin Pecan.
